changes.text: Grid line numbers for SAMPLR's slice turns (no change in the Looper itself)
Slicer with Q and LOOP: slices pressed together sound together on every grid line; slices pressed at different times start on their own lines and then take turns, one on each line, cycling
Good to know is a dropdown (closed by default).

Manual: page buttons under the picture, blue highlights, starts on item 1, picture and text side by side on wide screens; wording fixed (the Looper's sends go to the Blackbox's own delay and reverb; the eight buttons are not round; DRONE-8 X:, CYCLE and VERB; SAMPLR saves nothing of its own yet). New Good to know section: CPU, grains, memory, saving.
A Manual pop-up for Looper, SAMPLR, DRONE-8 and Trigger2MIDI: a picture of every page with the controls numbered and highlighted, and what each does. Version numbers are larger.
The install help section is removed.
Install help simplified: tells people what to send; the box of details to copy is gone.
The install help (unable to verify / firmware not found) is open by default.
Install help: details to copy and send (no GitHub needed); the page shows what it built with.
Version numbers for the patcher and each machine, a What's new list, a build summary with the file's size and checksum, install help; MCL moved to 5.10+.
First public version: pick any parts and add-ons, patch your own stock 3.1.9 in the browser.
Slice, Tape, Arp, Grain and Loop modes.
